# About me
Welcome! I’m Xinru (Violet) Zhao — a business analytics graduate with a passion for uncovering patterns in data and translating them into strategic decisions.

My portfolio showcases real-world projects in marketing analytics, NLP, and predictive modeling. From analyzing startup success trends using SQL, to boosting model performance for HR attrition analysis, each project reflects my focus on business impact, clarity of communication, and technical rigor.

I believe that great analysts do more than crunch numbers — they ask the right questions, tell compelling stories with data, and help teams move forward with confidence. Let’s connect.
